abi.calling_convention: Windows x86 __cdecl; argument [ESP+4], caller cleans 4 bytes, RET pops return address only
abi.parameters: one pointer to readable little-endian 16-bit units ending in zero; unaligned addresses supported by tested x86 builds
abi.return: signed 32-bit EAX: SAR32((end_pointer-start_pointer) mod 2^32,1)-1; ordinary strings return number of nonzero units
abi.side_effects: reads exactly one 16-bit unit per iteration through zero; input and nonvolatile EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP preserved; volatile registers and EFLAGS not promised
